label: defixs-finance.vercel.app
title: Defix-Finance | One-Stop DeFi Solution
reasons: A field named 'seedPhrase' is present in the page's bundled JavaScript, which is the operator's own code since the HTML body contains only an empty root div and a script tag.
The page presents options for Trust Wallet, WalletConnect, and Coinbase Wallet alongside the 'seedPhrase' field, indicating it is designed to harvest mnemonic phrases from users of these services.
The page's visible copy offers to 'rectify all strange wallet issues' and 'claim airdrop or resolve errors', which are common pretexts used to lure victims into entering their seed phrases.

label: hopebridge-foundation.vercel.app
title: HopeBridge Foundation
reasons: The page's JavaScript logs every keystroke in the form fields, including the 'accountNumber' field, and sends the data to the endpoint '/api/log' via a POST request.
The form asks for an 'accountNumber' under the pretense of signing up for more information about the charity, while secretly exfiltrating the data as the visitor types.
The AI policy section mentions 'account numbers' and 'sensitive information', providing a pretext for the field while the script captures and transmits it without disclosure.
